exposure: Epidural analgesia (EA) at cervical dilatation of 1 cm
Epidural analgesia (EA) at cervical dilatation >1 cm
outcome: Duration of labor (first, second, and third stages)
cohort: 686 multiparous women with previous successful vaginal deliveries who received epidural analgesia during their current delivery.
finding: Initiation of epidural analgesia at 1 cm cervical dilatation in multiparous women did not significantly affect the duration of labor, cesarean delivery rates, or neonatal outcomes.
